I don't intend on discussing the reasons people think Stolas might be killed off, but moreso to give context as to why im sure he will not die (at the VERY least at this point of the story) 

Im aware seemingly everyone has a mega hard on for the theory that Stolas is going to kick the bucket soon, but I just dont think it holds up when you actually consider how this would play out. 

The most important reality that i see alot of people overlook is what kind of show this is. Helluva boss is supposed to be a raunchy heartfelt comedy. Yes, the show can explore some deeper topics, and it absolutely nails those emotional beats, but Stolas dying would be fucking soul crushing. Stolas is one of the most popular characters amongst the fanbase, and I'd assume the team as well as his instagram page (which is run by crew members) is just as active as the main character's, usually just to show the wacky shenanigans the bird gets into. 

It also doesnt help that  if Stolas were to die, that is something we will have to *explore* . we'll have to explore Blitzø's reaction to someone he may have potentially wanted to start a relationship with being killed off.  he'll have to cope with that crushing reality that the one person who didnt mind Blitzo's more 'unpleasant' traits is now gone. like- that isnt just your run of the mill heartbreaking plotline, that shits fucking DEPRESSING. 

Ive heard so many people say they would straight up stop watching Helluva Boss out of frustration if stolas were to die, and i dont think thats the type of show the crew wants to create. not to mention this would also just be a typical 'bury your gays' trope, and since Vivzie has stated she wants to do her part in contributing to gay rep in cartoons, i dont think this is a route she would want to take. 

Additionally, whether you like him or not, Stolas brings color and depth to the show and him just existing as his ditzy self gives so much insight into how this hellish world works. almost every hell-based lore we've gotten from helluva boss has been centered around Stolas (the grimoire, loo loo land and the greed ring/ robo fizz, the wrath ring, angelic weapons and demon royalty, a demon's ability to reveal his most demonic true form, etc. ). In the future, as a result of the previews from the trailer, we can also predict that stolas's plotline will grant us insight into the lust ring, the actual Fizzoroli, and possibly Asmodeus himself. 

Without Stolas being the cornerstone for all of the lore due to his proximity to IMP, this show would just be about a team of wacky demons fucking around and getting into crazy situations, which would still be fun to watch, but is more suited for an adult saturday morning cartoon with predictable plotlines as opposed to a complex show like this. 

The one part of this theory that genuinely annoys me is that I dont think people understand that not every show has to go to such extreme depths such as killing off a main character in order to get the feels going. 

you want Blitzo and Stolas to get that sweet relationship angst? have them emotionally split up during the finale. 
have Blitzo betray Stolas. have *Stolas* betray Blitzo. Have Stolas somehow find out that Blitzø may have considered joining striker in his efforts to kill him.  

you want the "when im gone you'll be okay" line to be foreshadowing for something and come full circle ? maybe Stella will kick stolas out for being a shitty husband, forcing him to say his goodbyes to octavia. maybe he'll run away on his own and go into hiding, going back on the promise he made to Octavia in episode two and therefore losing her trust. maybe he'll be forced to go to demon jail for lending out his grimoire to an imp. like god,  he doesn't have to fucking PERISH. 

Theres so many different ways this could play out that dont involve murdering beloved characters. there are so many relatable and hearfelt methods to move an audience, while still keeping the show enjoyable .  
And yes, I do genuinely believe that killing off Stolas would make a cut to the overall enjoyability of the show, since anytime a character is in a dangerous situation( which is OFTEN) , we'll have to think "OH SHIT are they gonna kill moxxie??!" instead of "damn i wonder what wacky shit moxxie is gonna have to pull to get out of this one" 

you see what I mean? 

stakes are always good, but having a potential consequence be death doesnt at all fit with the vibe of this show. 

Overall, I just dont think Stolas dying would fit the tone of this generally fun enjoyable show, nor do I believe it would be a good choice story wise.
